```{r}


library(ggformula)
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(skimr)
library(babynames)
```

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = species))
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = island))
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = island, fill = species))
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_bar(~ species)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_bar(~ species, fill = ~ species)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_bar(~ species, fill = ~ island)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_bar(
    ~ species,
    fill = ~ island,
    position = "dodge"
  )
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_histogram(~ body_mass, bins = 50)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_histogram(
    ~ body_mass,
    bins = 50,
    fill = ~ species
  )
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_density(
    ~ body_mass,
    fill = ~ species
  )
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = flipper_len,
      y = body_mass,
      color = species
    )
  )
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_point(
    body_mass ~ flipper_len,
    color = ~ species
  )
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      x = body_mass,
      y = species
    )
  )
```

```{r}
species_graph <- penguins |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = species))
```

```{r}
bodymass_histogram <- penguins |>
  gf_histogram(
    ~ body_mass,
    bins = 50,
    fill = ~ species
  )

bodymass_histogram
```
```{r}
penguins |>
  gf_histogram(~ body_mass, fill = ~ sex)
```
```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarize(
    mean_weight = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
mosaic::t_test(body_mass ~ sex, data = penguins)
```
